rationale: All three combine the two independently validated engines: long-horizon cross-sectional mean reversion (ma 120-250, plateau confirmed across ret, ma, minr and maxr formulations at horizons 60-250) and a weekly return echo (returns from days t-8 to t-5 predict positively, with a coherent oscillating lag profile). The engines are nearly orthogonal, and blend train SR sits on a broad 1.9-2.16 plateau across weightings, horizon sets and rank vs z normalization, which argues the edge is structural rather than a selection artifact. Variants differ in reversal horizon set and a small kurt(250) add-on to hedge specification risk.
